title:
This condition validates the {@link DataPreparationApplicationState#numFeatureDataReports}, and
returns `true` if it is greater than 0.
If the number of {@link FeatureDataReport}s is greater than 0, it means that they were computed as part of the
dataset preparation process, and are available for use in the Dataset Preparation Details page.
It is used to determine whether to show the Selected Sensors Grid that uses {@link FeatureDataReport}s,
or the one that uses {@link SensorDataReport}s. I.e. we show {@link Feature}s data if feature data reports
are available, and {@link Sensor}s data if they are not.
name: DatasetPreparationSelectedSensorsRenderCondition
